category_title: Adolescents with ADHD exhibiting low levels of agency, chronic procrastination, and disorganized academic behaviors
scenario_title: Studying and memorizing facts in a quiet environment
minimal_context: The student is sitting at a separate desk in a quiet environment attempting to memorize facts for an upcoming test.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit at this separate desk away from the window and start memorizing these facts for your upcoming test.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don’t find myself a very effective studier … ’cause I can’t concentrate.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to focus on the material. What is going through your mind right now while you look at the study materials?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Man this is boring! Mostly just music, or nothing really.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to keep trying to memorize the facts so you can pass the exam.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Studying’s just stupid ’cause it doesn’t work. I can never master these basic skills, I guess I'm just too lazy to do things that take this much mental effort.

task.content: Attempting to study or memorize facts for tests/exams

context.social_setting: separate desks, as opposed to having students sit in groups; sitting away from the window

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: tasks that involve sustained mental effort, and hence intention and activity
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: struggle to focus when studying, stating that studying is stupid or boring
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: feelings of failure, disappointment, and even bewilderment at their inability to master basic educational skills
related_quotes: Studying’s just stupid ’cause it doesn’t work.
I don’t find myself a very effective studier … ’cause I can’t concentrate.

behavior_patterns.condition: When asked what is going through their minds while studying
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: responses ranged from, 'Man this is boring!' to 'music' to 'nothing really.'
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Only 4 referred to the work itself (e.g., 'just trying to memorize the facts')
